info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Update P2m By Dispute Id-spec
info.description: The Dispute Management API enables businesses to efficiently manage payment disputes by allowing updates to specific disputes identified by their unique dispute ID. Users can utilize this endpoint to amend details related to disputes, facilitating more effective resolution processes. This API is particularly valuable for financial institutions, e-commerce platforms, and customer support teams that handle payment-related issues. By providing an interface for updating dispute information, it helps ensure that all stakeholders have access to the most current data for informed decision-making.

patch.description: This operation allows you to update the details of a specific dispute identified by its unique ID. You can modify various attributes of the dispute as needed.

requestBody.description: This request body allows for the partial update of dispute details for a specific dispute identified by 'RES-100045'. The body must contain valid fields that can be modified, adhering to the defined schema.

200.description: Request completed successfully and the resource has been updated.
